calls.text: {"meetingId": "199", "tickets": [{"title": "Coordinate business sale planning handoff", "text": "Briefly document the expected sale structure, key advisors involved, estimated liquidity timing, tax issues to review, and next advisory handoff steps with the client's CPA and attorney.", "priority": "medium", "dueDate": "2024-08-02", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": "ef69e24e-b352-50b8-81a8-9d4035bd97bf", "subTasks": [], "evidence": "Serena asked for direct coordination with Jonah and Celia on sale structure, liquidity timing, escrow terms, and tax planning before recommendations on staging proceeds; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-08-02."}, {"title": "Liquidity Reserve Snapshot", "text": "Prepare a cash reserve for Serena Cloudpuddle’s spending, estimated taxes, mortgage payments, school costs, and support for her mother.
